news_headlines.title: Gartner: Global IT spending to grow by 13.5% this year
news_headlines.summary: Gartner forecasts global IT spending to reach $6.31 trillion this year, a 13.5% increase from 2025, primarily driven by investments in AI. The data center systems segment is expected to see the fastest growth at 55.8%, while IT services will remain the largest spending category exceeding $1.87 trillion. Software, especially generative AI, also shows strong growth, with device market growth slowing due to rising memory prices.

This achievement highlights Esquire Bank's growing merchant services platform and its significant contribution to the company's financial performance.

news_headlines.title: Kyndryl, Google Cloud target AI workloads with local data control

This collaboration is designed to preserve data sovereignty, meet regulatory and latency requirements, and support AI-driven workloads by maintaining local control over data residency and governance. The partnership aims to accelerate application modernization and improve cost efficiency for AI and data intensive workloads.
